answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. By the plume of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The ocean lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the reef is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
